Nice, but Not Worth A Special Trip
Feb 2026 • Couples
We read that this was a great place for authentic Italian food. We took an uber there from the Park Hyatt. It wasn’t close but a nice ride and Ubers are cheap in HCMC. We had hopes of finding a nice shopping area to browse around after lunch, but there really was nothing there. All we saw was a nice pottery store and nothing else. Sidewalks are clogged with motorcycles so it is difficult to walk. 

We were seated on the patio, more like a separate room with A/C. Our salads were good, nothing really special as well as the pasta. Good, but not outstanding. Tiramasu was good.

We were glad we went as we got to see lots of HCMC on the drive there and back. If you have time and want to have lunch I would consider it. Don’t miss other sights in HCMC just to go here.

Authentic flavors in a quiet garden.
May 2025 • Family
This restaurant is located on a quiet street in Thao Dien, in a garden equipped with vegetalized arbors and fans for anyone who wants to eat outside but also has an air-conditioned room.
We feasted on the daily menu, avocado bread with 2 large shrimp with a slightly smoky taste, cream chicken squirts with carrots and mushrooms and a passion fruit panna cotta.
Everything was excellent, very good service with the dishes of the 3 guests served at the same time which is quite rare in Vietnam and good value for money.
An employee equipped with an umbrella greets guests and escorts them to their vehicle.

Finding yourself back home in Vietnam
Dec 2023 • Couples
Great Christmas lunch during our holiday in Vietnam! For the occasion, we wanted to rediscover the flavors and colors of our cuisine and we really succeeded. The restaurant enjoys a beautiful space that is divided between an internal room and a dehors with outdoor tables or on the air-conditioned veranda. The menu is full of dishes, from the selection of starters, first and second courses, even to pizzas, cooked in the scenic station at the entrance to the restaurant. Although the clientele was predominantly Asian, the restaurant maintains a menu faithful to the tradition of Italian cuisine. The Italian dining manager welcomed us upon our arrival and made sure everything was going well during lunch, as were the rest of the staff, kind and attentive service. We selected some dishes from the special Christmas menu and others from the menu, all truly delicious! A note of praise for the tagliatelle with meat sauce and the risotto, cooked perfectly. In summary, a beautiful lunch, which allowed us to find a bit of Italy in Vietnam!
Highly recommended!
